in_sanskrit.name: Ruplal
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Red lotus
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Ruplal एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। A name derived from the Sanskrit words 'rup' meaning form or shape and 'lal' meaning red lotus. It represents the divine form of Lord Vishnu, who is described as having red colored lotus feet. This name is believed to bring wealth, prosperity, and the strength of a red lotus.
